hazards.name: Choking Sporebed
hazards.description: A bruised fungal bed clouds the route with bitter green spores.

hazards.name: Listening Brambles
hazards.description: Hooked vines tighten whenever the tower hears hurried footsteps.

hazards.name: Cinder Vent
hazards.description: A cracked furnace throat pulses before bathing the passage in sparks.

hazards.name: Mirror Flood
hazards.description: A clear surge hides the broken crystal edges beneath its reflection.

hazards.name: Frostfall Arch
hazards.description: Moon-cold masonry sheds a curtain of razor frost across the doorway.

hazards.name: Crown Pollen
hazards.description: Golden dust from the living crown stings like a field of tiny thorns.
